The state of a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> after <c:ffff00>{{medachange}}<c>. Its <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>Leg Type<c> and <c:ffff00>Leg Trait<c> change, and instead of its
<c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>' <c:ffff00>actions<c> it can use a unique action, <c:ffff00>Drive<c>. The
<c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> of the 4 {{part|pl}} merges into one, and the
<c:ffff00>{{response}}<c> to an <c:ffff00>attack<c> is <c:ffff00>{{defend}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{evade}}<c>. <c:ffff00>{{revert}}<c>
becomes usable, but not <c:ffff00>{{medaforce}}<c>. Each <c:ffff00>act<c> uses
10% of the {{charge_gauge}}, and <c:ffff00>charging<c> doesn't
raise it; below 10%, it is forcibly reverted.
